definitions: Tied up the wings and legs of (a bird) before cooking.
Tied up (someone) tightly with their arms and legs close to their body.
Supported (a roof, bridge, or other structure) with a truss or trusses.
examples: The chicken was trussed and ready for the oven.
He was trussed up like a chicken.
The old bridge was trussed with steel beams.
